## List all available datasets in psych350data {.unnumbered}


### Description

List all available datasets in psych350data



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>list_datasets()
</code></pre>


### Value

Character vector of dataset names.



### Examples
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
library("psych350data")

list_datasets()


```
